sloka: स चापि कालो ऽयमुपागत: शनैर्यथा मया नास्तिकवागुदीरिता ।निवर्त्तनार्थं तव राम कारणात् प्रसादनार्थं तु मयैतदीरितम् ॥ २.१०९.३९ ॥
transliteration: sa cāpi kālo 'yamupāgata: śanairyathā mayā nāstikavāgudīritā ।nivarttanārthaṁ tava rāma kāraṇāt prasādanārthaṁ tu mayaitadīritam ॥ 2.109.39 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, since the appropriate time has slowly come, I have uttered this. In order to persuade you to return and to propitiate you I have said these words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे नवोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the one hundredninth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
